Applying the edit now.","tool_calls":[{"index":0,"id":"call_00_rWkgJtJTkxGxkZRhZjt70291","type":"function","function":{"name":"apply_edit","arguments":"{\"file\": \"handler.ts\", \"content\": \"// Durable order workflow: reserve inventory as a replayable durable step,\\n// then dispatch a notify child handler via workflow.call at step depth 0.\\nimport { run, step } from \\\"zttp:durable\\\";\\nimport { call } from \\\"zttp:workflow\\\";\\nimport type { Spec } from \\\"zttp:types\\\";\\n\\nstructural OrderWorkflowGuarantees = Spec<\\n    | \\\"deterministic\\\"\\n    | \\\"state_isolated\\\"\\n    | \\\"no_secret_leakage\\\"\\n    | \\\"no_credential_leakage\\\"\\n    | \\\"input_validated\\\"\\n    | \\\"pii_contained\\\"\\n    | \\\"injection_safe\\\"\\n>;\\n\\nfunction handler(req: Request): Response & OrderWorkflowGuarantees {\\n    const key = req.headers.get(\\\"idempotency-key\\\") ?? \\\"order-workflow-demo\\\";\\n    return run(key, () => {\\n        const reservation = step(\\\"reserve_inventory\\\", () => {\\n            return { sku: \\\"SKU-100\\\", quantity: 1, reserved: true };\\n        });\\n        const res = call(\\\"notify\\\", {\\n            method: \\\"POST\\\",\\n            path: \\\"/notify\\\",\\n            body: { orderId: key, reserved: reservation },\\n        });\\n        return Response.json({\\n            orderWorkflow: true,\\n            runKey: key,\\n            childBoundary: \\\"workflow.call:notify\\\",\\n            subStatus: res.status,\\n        });\\n    });\\n}\\n\"}"}}]},"logprobs":null,"finish_reason":"tool_calls"}],"usage":{"prompt_tokens":37206,"completion_tokens":490,"total_tokens":37696,"prompt_tokens_details":{"cached_tokens":35584},"completion_tokens_details":{"reasoning_tokens":111},"prompt_cache_hit_tokens":35584,"prompt_cache_miss_tokens":1622},"system_fingerprint":"a26a7955944dc5c60445bff77fac9c8e"}
